title: Xanthe and the Wolf
author: Casper Yarrow
blurb: Elodie Eriksen, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
